reviews.comment: Everything worked when I tested it, including the accessories in the box.

Good value. I would order from this seller again.

reviews.comment: There were scratches around the connectors and it only worked intermittently.
I asked to return it and had to follow up twice.
Mine was usable, and the clearance price felt fair.
The condition could have been described more clearly.
I kept it because of the price, but would hesitate to buy again.
The seller did not reply after I reported the problem.
